entities.name: Query protein (330 aa)
observations: Sequence length 330 aa; predicted molecular weight 36.14 kDa and theoretical pI 6.55.
Contains Semialdhyde_dh (PF01118.31; residues 5–120) and Semialdhyde_dhC (PF02774.24; residues 139–313) domains.
Homologous to reviewed aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenases with 49.6–61.4% identity and 97.3–98.2% query coverage.
Best-supported function is aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase, EC 1.2.1.11; likely a homodimeric cytosolic enzyme inferred from reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
observations: Catalyzes reductive dephosphorylation of 4-phospho-L-aspartate using NADPH, yielding L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde, phosphate, NADP+, and H+.
Reaction representation: L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP(+) = 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H(+), corresponding to Rhea RHEA:24284 in the reported direction convention.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: The reaction is step 2 in pathways leading from L-aspartate toward lysine via diaminopimelate, methionine via homoserine, and threonine.
